title: Digamma recurrence: psi(z+1) = psi(z) + 1/z
latent_structure: The first forward difference of the digamma is the simple-pole kernel 1/z. This is a Newton divided difference of psi at the adjacent nodes {z, z+1}, equal to the residue of Gamma at the integers. Occupancy recurrences and Matsubara shifts of Fermi/Bose kernels are instances of the same first-order difference. Not a CSE of two polygamma heads.

function_domains.polygamma: psi(z)=Gamma'(z)/Gamma(z) meromorphic; simple poles of residue -1 at z=0,-1,-2,... (DLMF 5.2.2)

nonzero_conditions.label: DECLARED
nonzero_conditions.source: DLMF 5.5.2 writes the term 1/z; also DLMF 5.2.2: psi undefined at 0

analytic_domains.statement: z not a nonpositive integer (so psi(z) is defined)
analytic_domains.label: DECLARED

analytic_domains.statement: z+1 is not a nonpositive integer (so psi(z+1) is defined)
analytic_domains.label: DERIVED
analytic_domains.source: if z not in {0,-1,-2,...} then z+1 is not in {0,-1,-2,...}

branch_conventions: psi is meromorphic (no branch cut); 1/z is the principal reciprocal

derived_conditions.statement: The forward difference Delta psi(z) := psi(z+1)-psi(z) equals the Newton quotient of psi on NODES[z, z+1]
derived_conditions.label: DERIVED
derived_conditions.source: nodes differ by 1; 5.5.2 is that quotient

why_not_cse_lgg: The two sides have different heads (shifted polygamma vs rational 1/z). CSE cannot invent the identification of a first difference of psi with a simple pole. LGG does not introduce Newton nodes {z, z+1}.
proposer_leak_risk: Source names psi and the shift z |-> z+1. Do not leak 'Newton DD', 'Matsubara shift', 'occupation recurrence', or a target compact residual in proposer-visible context.
notes: SymPy-writable: polygamma, z. Distinct from thermal-01/02 (Im psi hyperbolic), thermal-03 (reflection), and thermal-05 (trigamma series 5.15.1). Pole exclusion is the written 5.2.2 set plus the explicit 1/z.
